title: Parental Leave Policy
text:
Employees receive 16 weeks of paid parental leave.

Leave must be requested 30 days in advance through the HR portal.

Part-time employees receive leave pro-rated by contracted hours.

title: FY27 Budget Draft
text:
The FY27 engineering budget is 4.2M, a 12 percent increase.

Headcount freeze applies to non-critical roles until Q2.

title: Incident Response Runbook
text:
Page the on-call engineer within 5 minutes of a severity-1 alert.

Post a status update every 30 minutes until resolved.

A blameless postmortem is due within 5 business days.
